steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ with a vendor bid, as required for a prepared-state case.

Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.

Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open Edit Evaluation Time, confirm the new evaluation timing, and verify that the update is accepted with the timing change recorded.
Verify the exact success feedback expected after confirming the evaluation-time edit.
